niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, creative needs, measurement requirements and target markets. To help you pick, here’s a short framework plus recommended options by category and a suggested next step.

How to choose
- Objective: brand awareness, direct response, subscriptions, app installs, etc.
- Buying method: programmatic (DSPs) vs. direct buys on streaming platforms.
- Creative: do you need short-form, dynamic/ad‑personalized creative, or long-form video?
- Measurement: third‑party verification, reach/frequency, ROI attribution across linear + CTV.
- Geography & scale: local, national, or global campaigns.
- Budget & timelines: programmatic scales easily; premium direct buys often need larger budgets and lead time.

Agencies/platforms to consider (by type)
- Major holding groups (full-service, broad inventory + measurement):
  - GroupM (WPP; Mindshare, Essence, Xaxis)
  - Omnicom Media Group (OMD, Hearts & Science)
  - Publicis Media (Starcom, Zenith)
  - Dentsu (Carat)
  - IPG (Initiative, UM)
- CTV-specialist platforms & partners (buying, ad ops, creative/mid‑to‑upper-funnel tech):
  - The Trade Desk (top DSP for programmatic CTV)
  - Roku Advertising, Amazon Ads, Google/YouTube (platform-native buys)
  - Innovid (creative/ad delivery + measurement for OTT/CTV)
  - Tremor Video / Unruly / SpotX (video ad platforms & marketplaces)
  - VideoAmp (cross‑platform measurement & optimization)
- Independent/digital-first agencies (often faster, more flexible for growth/performance):
  - Tinuiti, 72andSunny/independent shops with streaming practices, boutique CTV agencies (many regional specialists)

How to evaluate finalists
- Ask for case studies in your vertical and with similar KPIs.
- Review measurement stack: which verification vendors (DV, IAS, MOAT) and attribution partners they use.
- Ask how they access premium inventory (direct deals vs open exchange) and frequency capping strategy.
- Request an example media plan, creative approach, and expected CPM/CPV and reach metrics.
- Check references and campaign reporting cadence.

If you tell me: campaign objective, budget, primary markets, and whether you want programmatic vs. platform/direct buys, I can recommend 3–5 agencies or partners that are a good fit and explain why. Which details can you share?
